categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Hengwei Battery Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-performance environmentally friendly zinc-manganese batteries. The main products include alkaline zinc-manganese batteries and carbon zinc-manganese batteries, serving as OEM for international clients. The company also invests in button lithium-manganese batteries and is expanding production capacity overseas.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including MES systems, PLC control systems, Andon systems, and VMES for intelligent and automated battery production. It focuses on optimizing electrode materials, electrolyte formulations, and sealing technologies to enhance battery performance, safety, and environmental compliance. Continuous R&D efforts improve battery capacity, discharge performance, and anti-leakage properties.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are international well-known commercial chains and large trading companies primarily in Europe, North America, Japan, and South Korea. The products serve end markets including household appliances, electronic toys, medical devices, smart home products, and outdoor electronics. The company mainly exports its products, with a smaller portion sold domestically.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Jiaxing, Zhejiang Province, and has subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Singapore, and Vietnam. Its sales markets are concentrated in developed regions such as Europe, North America, Japan, and South Korea. The company is expanding production capacity in Vietnam to better serve global customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Hengwei operates primarily in the midstream segment of the battery supply chain, focusing on battery manufacturing and OEM production. It procures raw materials like zinc powder, electrolytic manganese dioxide, steel shells, and separator paper from upstream suppliers and delivers finished battery products downstream to commercial chains and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D to enhance battery capacity, discharge performance, environmental friendliness, and safety. Key projects include developing advanced electrode materials, gelled zinc paste, improved separator membranes, and lithium-manganese button batteries. It also focuses on intelligent manufacturing upgrades and expanding high-value product lines to strengthen global competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of battery products under OEM agreements. The company sells mainly finished alkaline and carbon zinc-manganese batteries to international commercial chains and distributors, with export sales accounting for the majority of revenue. Sales are conducted on a FOB basis for exports and direct delivery for domestic sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's zinc-manganese battery industry, competing with major domestic manufacturers like Fujian Nanfu, Zhongyin (Ningbo), Sichuan Changhong, Zhejiang Yema, and Guangdong Liwang. It holds a stable market position with advanced production technology and quality, but still has room to expand compared to the largest domestic competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 702 million, a 19.37% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 129.7 million, up 6.59%. Total assets reached RMB 1.5 billion, growing 7.42%. The company maintains steady growth driven by increased production volume and expanding overseas sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Hengwei emphasizes high-performance, environmentally friendly zinc-manganese batteries with superior electrical performance exceeding IEC and national standards by over 50%. Its products feature long shelf life, safety, and eco-friendliness (mercury, cadmium, and lead-free). The company leverages advanced manufacturing automation, rigorous quality control, and strong R&D capabilities to deliver reliable, cost-effective customized battery solutions for global customers.
